title: Tech Lead (f/d/m)
description: A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset. At CEEZER, we are architecting the infrastructure for enterprise-grade Climate Performance Asset management, transforming how the world's largest companies source and manage carbon credits, Energy Attribution Certificates (EAC), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel certificates (SAFc). Our platform gives the world’s most ambitious enterprises the data-driven precision, real-time monitoring, and framework-compliant reporting required to confidently deploy capital toward high-impact Climate Performance Asset portfolios and true, measurable climate action. Tasks Your mission We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. This role requires an ambitious technical leader who can architect scalable systems, navigate complex carbon data architectures, and drive engineering excellence. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one. Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows. Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices. Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack. Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards. Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure. Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions. Requirements What you need to succeed 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries. Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js. Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred). Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching). Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS. Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers. Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack. Benefits What's in it for you at CEEZER? A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets. Accelerated growth: We are scaling fast, and your career will too. Take opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives and expand your strategic influence. True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it. An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise. Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management. A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate. The hiring process An intro call with the People Team A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team Create an impact with us? We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you. Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive. If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

title: Marketing Manager
description: What you will work on Ark builds AI platforms for public administrations. We have won the German Startup Award 2026, raised 2.4mn in pre seed and grant money and approach 1mn in annual revenues. Tasks About the role We are currently mainly focussing on outbound leads - but see so many inbound opportunities. From webinars with >100 participants, to clients recommending our tool to an invite to advise the chancellor on AI. Since there are no marketing experts in the team, we are not yet capturing these opportunities. And this is why we are looking for a new colleague 🎉 As always in early stage startups, your role will include adjacent tasks, e.g., PR, social media or branding. Requirements What you bring along Your profile: We are looking for a marketer who is comfortable starting from a blank page: Marketing experience: around 3-5 years of hands-on B2B marketing experience, ideally in a startup, scale-up or similarly entrepreneurial environment. We care more about what you have built and learned than the exact number of years. Analytical rigour: You know how to evaluate the success of your channels and can tell us the difference between a channel that generates noise and one that generates pipeline. Creativity and messaging instinct: You can generate the material and messages we need for the different channels. The material has to land with our German public sector audience. Language: Excellent German and English (C1). Fluent French, Italian or Spanish is a plus. Benefits What you can expect from us 💸 Competitive Compensation Package We value your skills and expertise - enjoy a salary that reflects your impact. 🚀 Ownership & Growth from Day One Take on responsibility from the start, tackle exciting challenges, and accelerate your career with a steep learning curve. 🛖 Offices in both German Startup cities Offices in both, Berlin and Munich. Your home office is Berlin, but you are welcome to work fro the Munich office anytime. 🎉 Team Events & Culture Join a vibrant team with fun social events, and a culture of open feedback and continuous learning. 💛 Exclusive Perks & Benefits Stay active with an EGYM Wellpass / Urban Sports Club membership, plus enjoy discounts on top sustainability brands and Bike Leasing. Admin: Time commitment: Full-time Start date: ASAP Location: Berlin 🤗 We have a few things that matter to us, but we are not looking for a perfect checklist candidate. If you have built things, learned quickly and can show your impact, we would love to hear from you, even if your background does not match every point. Your team lead will be Ruth (Founder and CEO)

title: Key Account Manager Italy - Focus Business Development (all genders)
description: Welcome to Glow25! At Glow25, we unite beauty with science and cutting-edge technology – AI is a natural part of our everyday work. As Germany's leading collagen brand, we help people feel confident at every life stage and enhance their natural beauty. For our continued growth, we're looking for people with substance: reliable, motivated, and genuinely invested in building something meaningful together. We're looking for a Key Account Manager Italy who builds our business in the Italian market from the ground up — managing existing partners, securing new listings and actively developing ranges and promotions. Account Management — You manage existing customers and win new partners through compelling pitches and tailored product range proposals. Promotions & Trade Marketing — You plan and coordinate promotions, point-of-sale materials and sampling campaigns together with the marketing team. Cross-functional Collaboration — You work closely with internal teams across marketing, operations, regulatory and e-commerce. Market & Competitive Analysis — You keep an eye on trends, spot opportunities and develop new distribution ideas for the Italian market. Representation — You represent Glow25 at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events across Italy. You have the following experience: Several years of experience in key account management, ideally in FMCG, beauty or health A strong understanding of the Italian retail landscape — drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and grocery Fluent Italian and English Spanish is a nice to have (bonus if you can also work in/with Spanish-speaking partners or markets) A structured, proactive way of working with a real hands-on attitude Confident use of everyday tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Asana and a CRM system as well as AI Experience with pharmacy / parapharmacy channels — especially knowledge of the specific mechanics, decision processes and trade marketing setup in that environment is a bonus That's something you can look forward to: Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking. Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace. Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers. Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything. Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too! Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings. Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%. Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms. Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day. Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass. Yay! You've made it this far! But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Als (Senior) Sales Manager (w/m/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen. In dieser zentralen Rolle fungierst du als entscheidendes Bindeglied, das Interessent:innen in zufriedene LIQID-Kund:innen verwandelt. Dein souveränes Auftreten sowie deine umfassende Kompetenz prägen den Eindruck, den Interessent:innen von LIQID gewinnen, und überzeugen sie nachhaltig, sich für unsere maßgeschneiderten Anlagelösungen zu entscheiden. Du hast die Möglichkeit, dein Gehalt durch deine starke Leistung und Motivation flexibel zu gestalten. Was machst du dabei konkret? Proaktive Kundengewinnung: Du begeisterst neue Kund:innen im Segment der vermögenden Privatkundschaft und positionierst LIQID als starken, vertrauenswürdigen Partner im digitalen Wealth Management. Qualifizierte Ansprache: Auf Basis hochwertiger Leads nimmst du proaktiv Kontakt zu Interessent:innen auf, führst strukturierte Erst- und Folgegespräche und baust so von Beginn an eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung auf. Bedarfsgerechtes Informieren: Du präsentierst unser Leistungsangebot, analysierst die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen und entwickelst darauf abgestimmte Anlagevorschläge. Onboarding & Übergabe: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss sorgst du für einen reibungslosen Übergang der gewonnenen Kund:innen an unser Relationship-Management-Team. Team- & Marktfeedback: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Teamlead Sales und Kolleg:innen zusammen, teilst aktiv Feedback zu Kundenbedürfnissen, Markttrends und Materialien und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Vertriebsaktivitäten weiterzuentwickeln. CRM & Nachverfolgung: Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten strukturiert und transparent in unserem CRM-System und trägst so zu einer effektiven Nachverfolgung und Steuerung des Vertriebs bei. Das bringst du mit Background: Du hast ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium abgeschlossen oder eine Ausbildung in der Finanzbranche gemacht, zum Beispiel als Bankkaufmann/-frau, Investmentkaufmann/-frau oder Versicherungskaufmann/-frau. Außerdem bringst du erste Erfahrung im aktiven Vertrieb von Finanzprodukten mit, idealerweise in der Finanzanlagenvermittlung, Vermögensverwaltung oder im Banking. Du weißt also genau, wie man anspruchsvolle Kund:innen abholt und professionell informiert. Skills & Qualifikationen: Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Kapitalmärkte und Anlageprodukte und kannst komplexe Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend vermitteln. Mit deiner Akquisitions- und Abschlussstärke sowie deinem professionellen Auftreten gewinnst du schnell das Vertrauen neuer Kund:innen. Kommunikation ist deine Stärke; klar, empathisch und auf Augenhöhe. Außerdem bist du sicher im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Reporting-Tools und digitalen Vertriebsplattformen. Du sprichst sehr gut Deutsch, und gute Englischkenntnisse bringst du ebenfalls mit. Mindset: Du bist hochmotiviert, zielorientiert und packst Dinge gerne aktiv an. Sales ist für dich nicht nur ein Job, sondern etwas, das dich antreibt; du liebst den direkten Kundenkontakt und interessierst dich für Kapitalmärkte. Du arbeitest strukturiert, selbstständig und mit echtem Erfolgswillen. Gleichzeitig verbindest du Überzeugungskraft mit Empathie und einem starken Servicegedanken, genau das macht dich zu einer authentischen und überzeugenden Ansprechperson. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erster Austausch: In einem ersten Gespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team möchten wir die Gelegenheit nutzen, dich näher kennenzulernen und grundlegende Informationen zu besprechen. Videointerview mit dem Hiring Manager: In einem fachlichen Dialog prüfen wir, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen mit den Anforderungen der Position übereinstimmen. Persönliches Treffen: Hier hast du die Gelegenheit, das Team zu treffen und praxisnahe Einblicke in die Tätigkeiten eines Sales Managers zu gewinnen. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

title: Field Marketing & Partnerships Manager
description: Your Mission Cosuno is a B2B marketplace connecting general contractors and subcontractors across the construction industry. As our Field Marketing & Partnerships Manager, you'll build Cosuno's presence in the industry beyond our digital channels — trade fairs, conferences, partnerships and our own event formats. This isn't primarily an event-logistics role: you'll decide where Cosuno should show up, build formats and partnerships that make that presence matter, and turn every event and relationship into visibility, pipeline and proof points. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup. Your Responsibilities You shape event strategy alongside the marketing lead — identify and evaluate trade fairs, conferences and industry events worth Cosuno's time, and help build the annual calendar and budget priorities. You run events end-to-end — booths, logistics, suppliers, deadlines and on-site execution — working closely with Sales to bring the right prospects and customers into the room. You build Cosuno-owned formats — customer dinners, roundtables, breakfasts, workshops and webinars that bring customers, prospects and partners together. You build partnerships and industry relationships — media, associations, event organisers and commercial partners — finding ways to contribute expertise, not just sponsor or attend. You turn customers, experts and events into visibility — success stories, speaking, podcast and video opportunities, and reusable content for Marketing and Sales. You make it commercially valuable — target-account outreach with Sales, structured follow-up, and tracking what events and partnerships actually generate in relationships and pipeline, so no lead falls through the cracks. What You Bring You've owned events, field marketing, community or partnerships in a B2B environment and can show the commercial impact they created — not just attendance numbers. You've organised or owned trade fairs, conferences or field-marketing programmes end-to-end. You move comfortably between strategy and execution — contributing to decisions on which events are worth Cosuno's time, then sorting the last logistics detail yourself. You're a strong communicator and relationship-builder, confident approaching customers, executives, partners and suppliers — and you can prepare and coach speakers. You have a strong sense for what makes an event feel well executed, not just organised, and you'd rather build from scratch than follow a playbook. You think beyond attendance numbers — relationships, opportunities and pipeline — and work effectively across Marketing, Sales and Customer teams. Fluent German and strong English. Your Benefits Room to shape and grow: One of the first marketing hires — real ownership of events and partnerships, with plenty of space to make an impact. A product worth talking about: AI that analyzes millions of price data points to help construction companies bid better — something the industry actually wants to hear about at every fair and roundtable. Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Work-life balance: Berlin Kreuzberg office or hybrid, flexible hours. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events. Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Join us – Build the future of construction. Compensation: €55K – €70K • €55K – €70K

title: Senior Lifecycle & Retention Manager
description: Your Mission Cosuno is a B2B marketplace connecting general contractors and subcontractors across the construction industry. As our Senior Lifecycle & Retention Manager, you'll build the growth engine that turns new users into active, paying and retained customers — and move us toward an AI-native, signal-driven system that decides what happens next on its own. You'll be one of the first to join the marketing lead in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how it operates as it scales, not just execute inside a fixed setup. What you’ll do You build the CRM programmes and lifecycle journeys that drive adoption and conversion — from first tender discovery to paid conversion for subcontractors, and early product adoption to repeat tendering for construction companies. Together with the Marketing Lead, you build an agentic, signal-driven system that turns behavioural data, call insights and enrichment signals into personalised next-best-action triggers — replacing static journeys with ones that decide what happens next on their own. You experiment and measure with A/B tests and holdout groups, so decisions are based on incremental impact, not campaign output. You scale what works into a repeatable system, not one-off campaigns. You connect journeys with Sales and Customer Success, handing off to a human touch when that's more effective than automation. You use CRM as a lever for marketplace liquidity — getting the right subcontractors onto the right tenders — and orchestrate email, in-app, transactional comms and marketplace recommendations as one journey with Product. You support growth programmes such as referrals — from design through CRM execution. What You Bring You've owned CRM, lifecycle, retention or growth programmes and can show the commercial impact they created — ideally in B2B SaaS or a two-sided business model. You've directly influenced conversion, activation or retention metrics and are confident with data and experimentation. You're genuinely AI-native: proven experience building AI-driven automation or agentic CRM systems, not just using AI to write copy faster. You write and run SQL queries independently. You go from data → insight → idea → implementation → result without needing someone else to define every step, and you like solving ambiguous problems and building from scratch. You work effectively across Product, Sales, Customer Success and Engineering, and care more about measurable business impact than campaign output. A plus: hands-on experience with ActiveCampaign and Salesforce (or comparable CRM tools). Fluent in written and spoken German and English. Your Benefits Room to shape and grow: One of the first marketing hires — real ownership of lifecycle and CRM, with plenty of space to make an impact. AI at the core: Our product uses AI to analyze millions of price data points and help construction companies bid better — and we invest in it just as much internally. You'll build with the latest tools and move fast, not wait for approval. Competitive compensation: Salary above market average, permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company. Work-life balance: Fully remote or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg, flexible hours. Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro. A great team: Open, international, with regular off-sites and team events. Growth & feedback: Open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations. About us Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology. We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity. Join us – Build the future of construction. Compensation: €65K – €85K • €65K – €85K

title: Senior Data Analyst
description: Your mission We're a small data team with a big job: helping everyone at Cosuno make better decisions. Our data platform is stable and in good hands. What we need now is someone who takes our most important, open-ended business questions and answers them properly: in depth, with little guidance, and often before anyone thought to ask. You'll work across product and commercial topics. How do general contractors and subcontractors actually use our platform? What makes some accounts grow into company-wide rollouts? Which levers move our funnel the most? You'll work closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success and leadership, and we expect you to have opinions. In your first few months, you might: Work out what drives account growth: which behaviours predict long-term retention and expansion, and how Sales and Customer Success can act on them. Map how our customers really use the product: which workflows stick, where new features find their audience, and what healthy adoption looks like in an account's first months. Pick a question nobody has asked yet, answer it, and change a product or go-to-market decision with the result. Build the dbt models and Looker views your analyses need, so the next person can answer the question themselves. How we work Questions Over Tickets: You don't wait for requests. You figure out what matters and go after it. Depth Over Dashboards: One analysis that changes a decision beats ten reports nobody reads. Pragmatic by Default: Simple processes, fast iterations, and the lightest method that gives a trustworthy answer. Clarity Wins: A finding is only as good as how well others understand it and act on it. AI-Native by Default: We work heavily with Claude Code and other AI tools and expect everyone to use them fluently. Your profile 5+ years in analytics at fast-growing startups or scaleups, ideally B2B SaaS, where your work shaped product or commercial decisions. An exceptional ability to reason through ambiguous business problems: framing the right question, choosing a sound approach, and landing on a clear recommendation. Hands-on experience in both product analytics (usage, adoption, engagement, experimentation) and commercial analytics (retention, expansion, funnel, pricing). A track record of driving your own analytical agenda with minimal guidance. Strong SQL and professional experience with dbt and a BI tool (a strong command of Looker is a big plus). You build the models and views you need instead of waiting for them. Solid Python for analysis and scripting. Strong, hands-on familiarity with AI tools, especially Claude Code, and a habit of using them in your daily work. Excellent written and spoken English. You can explain a complex finding in one clear paragraph. Bonus Experience with marketplaces or two-sided platforms. Experience in vertical SaaS, construction tech or procurement. Experience with BigQuery. Compensation: €80K – €100K • €80K – €100K

title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. title: Founder's Associate
description: Norman is building an AI accountant that helps small businesses manage invoicing, accounting, and taxes. We’re a small team based in Berlin. As Founder's Associate, you’ll work directly with the founders across the full customer loop. You’ll talk to customers in German, help them get into the product, support them when they’re stuck, and help them decide whether to buy—honestly, not with a hard sell. Beyond that, you’ll take on business development, product feedback, and ops work that keeps Norman moving. This is a broad early-stage role across customer success, support, BD, product, and ops. Full-time, remote within Germany. Tasks Take inbound calls and chats with people who found Norman and want to know if it fits their business. Run demos and guided walkthroughs in German, tailored to their workflow. Help people onboard: setup, first tasks, and day-to-day product questions. Identify product gaps and opportunities for improvement from these conversations. Help get them to production. Own the purchase conversation: clarify fit, handle objections, and help suitable customers decide and get started. No sales quota or commission today—judgment and follow-through matter more than pressure. Support current users when they’re stuck or considering next steps (customer support + success). Help with business development: partnerships, outbound experiments, and turning strong conversations into pipeline where it makes sense. Use Norman every day, catch friction early, and feed clear examples back into product. Work with founders on product priorities: document recurring questions, objections, and workflow gaps; help turn them into better onboarding, help content, and product decisions. Take on ops work that keeps a small company running smoothly (process, tools, follow-ups, light project ownership). Help with webinars, short product videos, or a small community as we grow education around Norman. Requirements Native-level German (spoken and written) for confident, natural customer conversations. Willingness to wear many hats in an early-stage startup—CS, support, BD, product feedback, and ops in the same week. Strong listening: ask useful questions, explain software patiently, and avoid jargon. You learn products and processes fast and care why people (and systems) get stuck. You stay organized and follow through across calls, tickets, BD threads, and internal ops. Based in Germany. Nice to have: SaaS/fintech experience or experience with tools for Freiberufler and small businesses. Familiarity with invoicing, bookkeeping, or German tax workflows (no Steuerberater required). CRM experience; you’ve done demos, support, partnerships, or light ops/project work before. Interest in teaching in public (webinars, short videos, community). Benefits Work remotely within Germany. Direct work with founders in a small team—high ownership, real impact. Broad mandate across customers, product, and the company—not a siloed role. Your feedback and work show up quickly in how Norman grows. Interested? Send your CV or LinkedIn plus a short note covering your customer-facing (or early-startup) experience, why this role, and one example of helping someone get unstuck—a customer, a process, or a product.

title: (Senior) Web Analyst (m/f/d)

As pioneers in this space, we combine sustainability with on-demand personalization, enabling individuals and businesses to express their unique identities through bespoke creations. Join us to be part of a global leader in the exciting world of personalized apparel and lifestyle products! As we continue to expand our business, we are seeking a curious and passionate individual to join our team as the (Senior) Web Analyst (f/m/d) and drive our business forward. What Will Your Role Be We're looking for a Senior Web Analyst to own and evolve our digital measurement ecosystem. You'll help us understand how millions of users interact with our digital products and turn that understanding into better product and business decisions.You'll work at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Engineering, ensuring that our tracking is accurate, scalable and future-proof. From defining measurement strategies to implementing tracking solutions and uncovering actionable insights, you'll play a key role in improving our digital products and customer experience. This is not a generic Data Analytics or Data Science role. We're looking for someone with a strong background in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics who enjoys solving real business problems through reliable data. What You´ll Do Own Digital Measurement Own and continuously improve our digital measurement landscape across multiple digital products. Design, implement and optimise client-side and server-side tracking solutions. Ensure accurate, scalable and privacy-compliant data collection. Drive Measurement Strategy Translate business questions into measurement concepts and technical tracking requirements. Define KPIs and success metrics together with Product, Marketing and business stakeholders. Develop tracking specifications for new products, features and customer journeys. Generate Insights Analyse user behaviour, customer journeys and conversion funnels. Build dashboards and reporting solutions that enable data-informed decision making. Identify optimisation opportunities and provide actionable recommendations. Experiment and Optimise Design, implement and evaluate A/B tests and experimentation initiatives. Measure the impact of new features, campaigns and product improvements. Continuously improve tracking quality, measurement standards and analytics processes. Collaborate Across Teams Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Marketing teams. Present analytical findings in a clear and actionable way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Help establish analytics best practices across the organisation. What You´ll Bring Several years of experience in Web Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics or Product Analytics. Hands-on experience with modern tracking implementations and digital measurement architectures. Practical experience with tag management systems such as Adobe Experience Platform Tags or Google Tag Manager. Experience with Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4 or comparable enterprise analytics platforms. Solid knowledge of JavaScript and experience with SQL and/or Python. Experience with client-side and server-side tracking. Strong analytical thinking combined with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset. A solid understanding of data quality, tracking validation and analytics governance. Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Excellent written and spoken English. Nice to Have Experience with Product Analytics platforms. Experience with Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau. Experience with BigQuery, Snowflake or similar cloud data environments. Experience with experimentation platforms. Knowledge of privacy regulations and consent management. Experience in e-commerce or digital consumer products. Why Should You Join Us Autonomy and Impact: We believe in giving people real ownership. You'll have the freedom to make decisions, take action, and see the direct impact of your work on the business. Development and Growth: We believe that the greatest professional and personal growth happens when you're challenged. If you're looking to build your career, you'll find plenty of opportunities to do so. description: Introduction We are smartmicro, the leading specialist in high-performance automotive and traffic radar- and radar/camera hybrid sensor technology. You cooperate closely with embedded software, system engineering, testing and product teams to ensure reliable integration into our sensor platforms Your work contributes to safety-critical and high-performance radar applications, for example by improving traffic flow, protecting vulnerable road users and enabling robust radar-based perception in airborne use cases Your Strengths We are looking for an engineer with proven professional experience in algorithm development, not only an academic background. You have completed a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics or a comparable technical field You have some years of full-time professional experience in industrial or commercial algorithm/software development after graduation (Internships, thesis work, student jobs and purely university-based projects do not count toward this requirement) You have practical experience with at least one of the following areas: multi-object tracking, sensor fusion, radar tracking, object-level fusion, nonlinear state estimation, statistical signal processing, perception algorithms or probabilistic methods You are confident in programming with Python and C or C++ and can write structured, maintainable and testable code You have a solid mathematical foundation, especially in linear algebra, statistics, probability theory, estimation theory and filtering methods Experience with radar systems, camera systems, automotive sensors, ADAS, automated driving, intelligent traffic systems, embedded systems, real-time applications, drone tracking, UAV/UAS applications, airborne radar or radar altimeters is a strong advantage Knowledge of tracking methods such as Kalman filters, EKF, UKF, particle filters, JPDA, MHT, Bernoulli filters, PHD filters or extended object tracking is beneficial You are able to analyze complex technical problems independently and convert your findings into reliable software solutions You work in a structured, delivery-oriented way and can balance technical quality with project constraints. You communicate clearly in English; German language skills are an advantage What you can expect from us Innovation: latest technology, innovation and rapid development cycles, excellent work- and test equipment Pleasant working environment: informal culture, motivated teams, short communication channels, room for active participation Future-oriented workplace: modern buildings, offices and labs, permanent employment and individual training opportunities Attractive location: located directly next to the highway, direct bus stop at our facilities, parking facilities for cars and bikes, free charging of electric vehicles Flexible working: hybrid working (4 days office presence per week) Activities: team events, gym membership and more Other benefits

Solid understanding of AI, data, and the AI lifecycle; technically fluent enough to challenge decisions and understand trade-offs. Experience driving technology, process, or organizational change and supporting adoption. Strong ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting priorities, and build alignment. Excellent communication skills; able to simplify complex topics and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical audiences. Experience managing complex projects, timelines, risks, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders. Fluent in English and German. description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. title: Full-Stack Engineer
tags: AI | Software Development | Claude | Claude Code | IT
description: Deine Rolle Wir bauen Renewa One – das zentrale System, mit dem wir die Sanierung von Gebäuden managen. Wir entwickeln radikal anders als die meisten: KI-first mit Claude Code. Der Code entsteht schnell und in großer Menge – die eigentliche Kunst liegt nicht mehr im Tippen, sondern im Beurteilen, Zusammenführen und Verantworten. Deine Mission Du entwickelst neue Features unseres Sanierungs-Management-Systems – KI-assistiert und auf Basis unserer bestehenden Architektur. Du bringst Pull Requests verlässlich zum Release: reviewen, testen, Konflikte lösen und dafür geradestehen, dass nur sauberer, korrekter Code live geht. Du bist die entscheidende Qualitätsinstanz für KI-generierten Code – du erkennst die subtilen Fehler, die eine grüne Pipeline nicht sichtbar macht. Du hältst die Codebase konsistent und wartbar: gemeinsame Muster und ein sauberes Datenmodell statt Wildwuchs. Du verantwortest den Weg von der Idee bis zum Release mit – damit Features schnell und in guter Qualität bei den Nutzern ankommen. Dein Profil Erfahrung mit Claude Code: Du entwickelst KI-first mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren KI-Coding-Agents) und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen. Bei uns ist das die Grundlage der Arbeit, kein Bonus. Full-Stack-TypeScript mit echter Tiefe: Du bist im Frontend (React) sattelfest und kannst Backend-Code – APIs, Datenbank-Queries, Services – selbst schreiben und korrigieren. Nur so kannst du ihn wirklich beurteilen statt nur durchwinken. Urteilsvermögen fürs Merge-Gate: Du liest Pull Requests kritisch, gibst klares, konstruktives Feedback und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, was released wird. PostgreSQL & Datenmodellierung: Du verstehst Transaktionen, Indizes, Fremdschlüssel und Migrationen – und behandelst das Schema als langlebigen Contract, nicht als Wegwerfartikel. Sauberes Git-Handwerk: Rebase, Merge-Konflikte, CI-Pipelines und ein Branch-basierter Workflow sind für dich Alltag. Disziplin statt Ego: Du arbeitest mit den bestehenden Mustern des Teams, statt bei jedem PR deine eigene Meinung durchzudrücken. Du wohnst bereits in Hamburg: Diese Stelle ist nicht remote zu besetzen. Du solltest bereits in Hamburg oder im Umland wohnen und bereit sein, mehrmals in der Woche aus unserem Büro in Winterhude zu arbeiten. Deutschkenntnisse auf C-Level: Um intern gut mit unseren Mitarbeitenden zu kommunizieren und ein Verständnis für ihre Wünsche und die fachlichen Ansprüche zu entwickeln, sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse notwendig. title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
tags: utum | venture capital | AI | Student | Thesis | Data engineering | Prototyping
description: About us UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own. What we offer Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors. Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! Diversity is important to us Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability. Contact Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany www.uvcpartners.com UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer. UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM.

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description: Revenue Operations Associate Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Deine Mission Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln. trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen. Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen. Über trawa trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen. Das Team Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du verantwortest den Angebotsprozess und erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie. Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen Vertragsmanagement: Du prüfst Verträge für unsere Großkund:innen und stellst sicher, dass unser Vertragswerk passgenau zu ihren Anforderungen passt. Vertriebsstrategie und Planung: Du unterstützt bei Pipeline-Reviews, Forecasts sowie bei der allgemeinen vertrieblichen Steuerung. Was du mitbringst Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen. Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung. Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten. Deine Ziele Nach sechs Wochen: Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis zu unserem Geschäftsmodell, unserem Produkt und den energiewirtschaftlichen Kontext aufgebaut. Du hast alle wichtigen internen Stakeholder aus Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance und Product kennengelernt und verstehst, wie die einzelnen Teams mit Revenue Operations zusammenarbeiten. Du hast unser CRM-, CPQ- und Reporting-Setup vollständig kennengelernt und kannst dich selbstständig in Deal-Daten und Pipeline-Ansichten orientieren. Du hast einen vollständigen Deal-Zyklus begleitet – von der Opportunity bis zum unterschriebenen Kundenvertrag – und verstehst unseren aktuellen Deal-Desk-Prozess und hast schon erste kleinere Verbesserungspotenziale identifiziert. Nach drei Monaten: Du steuerst unsere Deal-Desk-Prozesse selbstständig. Du hast dich als verlässliche Ansprechperson im Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um Deals und die Angebotsprozesse etabliert. Du identifizierst kontinuierlich Optimierungspotenziale in unseren Prozessen und treibst ihre Weiterentwicklung aktiv voran. Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und unterstützt sie mit pragmatischen, passgenauen Lösungen. Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe. Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an. Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken. Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Warum trawa? Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt. Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung. Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können. Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents. Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

title: Accounting Lead
description: Accounting Lead Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ) Our mission for you Build the Finance function that carries the German Mittelstand through the energy transition, powered by green energy, sharp processes, and modern tooling. trawa enables mid-sized companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're growing fast in a hypergrowth environment, operating in one of the most complex regulatory markets in Germany. Energy accounting is genuinely complex and exciting, from PPA and spot to futures and direct marketing. We're looking for an Accounting Lead who takes real ownership of Accounting and Finance Operations, with a clear center of gravity in Quote-to-Cash : how customer contracts turn into invoices, receivables, and recognized revenue in an energy scale-up. Alongside taking our Accounting function to the next level under HGB, this is where you'll leave the biggest mark: turning Q2C from firefighting into a designed, scalable process. What you'll own Quote-to-Cash & Revenue Recognition Take Q2C to the next level: own invoicing, AR, and dunning end to end. Don't just run them – redesign them into scalable, partly automated processes together with Business Ops, Sales, and Tech. Own Revenue Recognition across our energy products, including PPA, spot, futures, and direct marketing. Write the policy, document it, and defend it with our auditor. Shape how billing-relevant customer and contract data is structured across systems. Accounting Own the monthly and annual close under HGB end to end. Your team runs the execution; you set the standard, the cadence, and the quality bar. Own tax coordination with our external advisor, VAT, and internal controls. Redesign core Accounting processes with a clear focus on automation, and build the documentation that makes us audit-ready: process descriptions, close checklists, controls, and audit trails. Define energy-specific accounting principles together with external advisors. Lead our first full external audit as the single point of contact for our auditors. Team leadership Take full functional and disciplinary responsibility for your team, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and development. Coach the team on structure, prioritization, and project delivery – not just technical accounting. Work cross-functionally with Business Ops, Tech, Sales, Treasury/FP&A, our external tax advisor, and auditors. Your first 90 days Month 1 – Understand and shadow: Get deep into our business model, the complexity of the energy market, and our Accounting and Finance Operations landscape. Meet key stakeholders across the team, our tax advisor, Business Ops, and Tech. Shadow the recurring close, run by your team, and map the Q2C process end to end. Month 2 – Take first ownership: Take over Q2C as process owner, identify the highest-impact inefficiency in invoicing or AR, and deliver a first structural improvement. Start owning the close as team lead and document gaps in processes and controls. Month 3 – Own the roadmap: Own Accounting and Finance Operations end to end. Set the roadmap for audit readiness, documentation, internal controls, and the target data model together with Business Ops and Tech. Who you are Must-haves 6+ years of hands-on Accounting experience with a strong HGB foundation and ownership of the monthly and annual close, including audit experience. A proven track record of structurally redesigning Quote-to-Cash – including invoicing, AR, dunning, and revenue recognition – rather than simply running it. You've reshaped a Q2C process at least once and can walk us through what changed, why you changed it, and what the impact was. People leadership experience with full ownership : you've led at least two people and were responsible for hiring, performance, and development. You can point to how they grew under your leadership. A process design and automation mindset. You're openly opinionated about modern, lean tool stacks. Business-fluent English and German at B2+ level – enough to work with HGB, DATEV, tax advisors, and auditors. Nice-to-haves Experience in the energy market, for example PPA, spot, futures, or direct marketing. Experience with ERP selection or rollout. Familiarity with IFRS. Hands-on experience with tools in our stack: DATEV, Moss, Airtable, n8n, and Langdock. Don't worry if you don't match every box. We value ownership, process instinct, and learning speed over perfect CVs. What we offer Real ownership in a high-impact role: Accounting and Finance Operations are yours to shape, and Q2C is where you can leave your signature. A role that grows with the company: trawa is scaling fast, and our Finance organisation is scaling with it. This role comes with genuine headroom: as the function grows around you, so do your scope, your team, and your seniority. We build careers here, not job descriptions. The opportunity to lead our first full external audit: a milestone that takes most people years to reach. The chance to shape an AI-first Finance stack from scratch: not maintain someone else's legacy. Direct contact with our founders and senior leadership. A uniquely complex business model at the intersection of energy, technology, and finance. Flexible working, 30 vacation days, an L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, an Urban Sports membership, and a vibrant Berlin office culture.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. Drive end-to-end prototyping and series production: Build PCBs, circuits, and wiring systems, taking dynamic initial concepts all the way through to scalable manufacturing. Establish engineering processes: Build standard QA frameworks, engineering gates, and operational systems that allow the team to stay focused, execute rapidly, and succeed. Ensure quality, compliance, and safety: Act as the primary gatekeeper for electrical quality while navigating applicable industry safety standards and regulatory compliance. Engine for high-speed execution: Balance fast-paced autonomous robotic iteration with pragmatic, right-sized QA processes tailored to current development stages. Design motion system architectures: Develop and optimize 24V/48V power distribution, motor/servo drive integration, and sensor interfaces to ensure high signal integrity and thermal efficiency. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with firmware and software teams on board bring-up, microcontroller integration, and system-level debugging. Manage DFM/DFT and supplier relationships: Work directly with contract manufacturers and in-house assembly teams to oversee BOM costs, component sourcing, and engineering change control. We're looking for someone who has: Completed vocational training or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a comparable field. Several years of experience in full-cycle electrical design (analog, digital, and power circuits) across multiple companies, taking products from concept to market. Deep technical background in Altium, multi-layer PCB layout, microcontrollers (ARM Cortex, STM32), motion systems (24/48V power, motor drives, encoders, sensor interfaces), and EMC/thermal layout strategies. Solid grasp of DFM/DFT principles, cable harness design, signal integrity, and direct collaboration with contract manufacturers. Proactive, end-to-end ownership mindset with a pragmatic working style and a drive to establish scalable processes in a high-growth environment. Very good English skills (German is a plus). Nice to have: Familiarity with industrial protocols (EtherCAT, Profinet, Modbus, CAN, Ethernet) and exposure to relevant standards/safety concepts (CE/Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, EMC standards, STO, PL/SIL). Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? title: AI Growth Marketer (m/w/d) - remote
tags: AI | Marketing | KI | Design | Agency | Builder | Agency Builder | Produktmanagement
description: Deine Rolle Wir sind ein kleines, agiles Marketing-Team. Jede und jeder übernimmt hier Ownership, entwickelt eigene Strategien und setzt sie selbst um. Deshalb holen wir jemanden dazu, der sich alles übergreifend ansieht, die größten Hebel erkennt und sie selbst in die Hand nimmt. Du verantwortest Growth-Projekte end-to-end, auf bestehenden Kanälen und auf neuen, die Du selbst findest. Du baust selbst, stellst selbst live in der App, im App Store oder auf der Website, und wertest die Daten danach aus. Die Wege sind kurz, der komplette Projektzyklus liegt bei Dir. Deine Aufgaben: Chancen in unseren Produkten finden. Du gehst regelmäßig durch Website, App Stores, Content, Jobboards und den Funnel bis Premium und findest die Stellen mit dem größten Hebel für Registrierungen und Umsatz. Chancen im Markt erkennen. Du schaust genauso nach außen: Welche Trends und Plattformen bewegen unsere Zielgruppe gerade, welche Segmente oder Märkte lohnen einen Einstieg, welche Wachstumskanäle sollten wir aktivieren, die wir heute nicht nutzen, und was machen Wettbewerber. title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
tags: Engineer | Software Developer | KI | AI | Artificial Intelligenz | Künstliche Intelligenz
description: Our Company "Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!" We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step. This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen. Your Mission End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing. Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt. Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities. Data Modelling & Scalable Systems: Build solid data models and scalable architectures that serve as a reliable foundation for our products. Turn repeated work into shared building blocks (UI components, data import flows, AI pipelines) so each new tool is faster to build than the last. Stakeholder Collaboration & Adoption: Work with stakeholders at all levels - from leadership to operations - to align on priorities and drive adoption of new tools and features. Communicate technical concepts clearly and build buy-in for your solutions across the organisation. Continuous Improvement: Gather feedback early, iterate quickly, and continuously improve what you build.
